'''Trann Shoame''' was the leader of the [[Qektoth Confederation]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Under Shoame's leadership, the Confederation cut a deal with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] to trade biological weapons for ships and crews, and forged ahead with the development of a deadly biological weapon.
